meaning:
ὑπ-εναντίος, -α, -ον
[in LXX for אָיַב, צַר, etc. ;]
set over against, opposite. Metaphorical (Plat., Arist., al.), opposed to, contrary to: with dative of person(s), Col.2:14; absol., as subst., ὁ ὑ., Heb.10:27 (cf. Isa.26:11).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.
but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
